description: Contacts: delete one entry from a contact's history (interaction_id from get_person_interactions or log_interaction), e.g. one logged by mistake or for the wrong person. The contact is unchanged. If it was their latest, their last interaction becomes the next latest entry (none if it was the only one) and the next check-in follows. Confirm with the user first. Returns change_id: undo_contact_change(change_id) adds it back. Requires API key or OAuth with context.write and context.delete. ($0.05; API key required)

interaction_id.description: The interaction id from get_person_interactions or log_interaction.
